acquisition method: The timsTOF Pro operated in PASEF mode, selecting precursors with charge states 0 to 5 for fragmentation and acquiring 10 PASEF-MS/MS scans per cycle.
cleavage agent: Trypsin/P was specified as the cleavage enzyme, allowing up to 2 missing cleavages.
enrichment method: Utilizing immunoprecipitation (IP) and liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS), a plethora of proteins were identified as putative interactors with SmD2
instrument: Peptides were analyzed using the timsTOF Pro (Bruker Daltonics) with a capillary source and an electrospray voltage of 1.60 kV.
ionization type: Peptides were analyzed using the timsTOF Pro (Bruker Daltonics) with a capillary source and an electrospray voltage of 1.60 kV.
